explanations.text:
[name_to_map](name_to_map)(name, project_root):
    takes file name and:
        if folder path, return human/abstraction_<folder?>.json and sort type folder.
        if a file's abstraction like app.py then returns human/abstraction_src__app.py.json and sort type file.
        if a new abstraction. which abstracts to multiple files. then it's not a single file's abstraction and it's human/human_<name>.json, and sort type human file.
 if a file at the top of the folder answers to a human file bare name. human init gives a warning.

[find_root](find_root)(path)                  
 given a path return the folder at or above path that holds human/human.json
 before it returns, it moves the old maps of that folder to their new names


[rel_name](rel_name)(code_path, project_root)
 the path of a file from the root, like src/app.py


[map_path_of](map_path_of)(code_path, project_root)
 the map file of a code file: human/abstraction_<path>.json, the slashes written as __
 if map is folder, it gets its own map the same way

[human_place](human_place)(root, name)
 read the human file's map.
 return the folder a human file shows in
 if empty, return emty text

[human_entries](human_entries)(root)
 every human file of the project: its bare name and that folder, for human.json
